title: SC Wharf - water processing (in lab)
author: Kendra Negrey

steps_raw.instruction: SCW Weekly Processing Supplies
Filter manifold/vacuum pump
4 - Square PC 500mL bottles (acid wash #4)
500mL coated glass filter flask w/filter cup (acid washed)
2 – Polycarbonate filters (10um)
1 – Poretics filter (0.2um)
50mL saline ethanol (for WCP)
Mix 45mL of 80% EtOH with 5mL of 25X SET
Lugols transfer pipet (in dead cabinet)
Dead pipette bulb (in dead cabinet)
6 – 2mL cryovials (DAP, FCM, dDA)
1 – 2mL bead beater vial (DNA)
5 – chl tubes/caps (CHL1-2)
2 – 50mL Corning tubes (UREA, NH4)
1 – 20mL plastic scintillation vial (Nutrients)
1 – 20mL glass scintillation vial (0.8% PFM)
2 – 100mL glass French Square bottles (FORM, LUGOLS)
1 – WCP rack (7x15mL, 1x50mL) (WCP)
1 – CDPH plastic bottle (in D436 dead cabinet)
SCW Weekly Processing Procedure
**Make sure sample is well mixed before pouring out of bottle and before sampling out of tri-pour.**
Add 150 mL whole water to bottle #1
Filter WW through a 0.2 um poretics filter
Place filter into the bead beater vial
Store DNA filters in -80o freezer (Box label - KUDELA SCW DNA#)
Add 250 mL whole water (WW) to PC bottles
Filter WW through a GF/f filter
**Collect filtrate from bottle #4 in filter flask (both acid washed beforehand)
Place each filter into a cryovial (or plastic tube) – ONE filter per vial
Store DAP filters in -80o C freezer (Box label - KUDELA SCW DAP#)
Filter 25 mL whole water through a GF/f (perform twice on separate filters)
Filter 25 mL whole water through a 10um PC (perform twice on separate filters)
Place each filter into a glass chl tube
Add 7 mL of 90% acetone to each tube
Store in Kudela Lab freezer (-20 o C) and run samples within 24 hrs
Urea/Ammonium/Nutrients
**Use filtrate collected in DAP procedure
Fill one 50mL tube with 25 mL of filtrate (Ammonium) and one tube with 20 mL of filtrate (Urea)
Rinse plastic scintillation vial with filtrate 3 times.
After 3rd rinse fill vial with ~20 mL of filtrate (Nutrients)
Parafilm the tubes and vial
Store in Kudela Lab freezer (-20 o C)
**Use filtrate collected in DAP procedure
Pour 1.8 mL into a cryovial, process same day OR store at -80oC
Pipet 100 mL WW into each French square bottle
Add 10 mL of 37% formaldehyde to one (FORM)
Add 2 mL of acid Lugols to the other (LUGOLS)
Store in cold room (Box labels - KUDELA SCW WW FORM and KUDELA SCW WW LUGOLS)
Pipet 1.8 mL WW into cryovial
Add 2 drops of 4% paraformaldehyde
Store in -80oC freezer (Box label - KUDELA SCW Bacteria/FCM#)
Pipet 16 mL of the net tow into the glass scintillation vial
Add 4 mL of 4% paraformaldehyde
Store in cold room (Flat label - KUDELA SCW NET PARAFORM archive)
Add 100 mL of net tow to the pre-charged CDPH bottle
Label with lab tape and leave in D436 fume hood
*Wear gloves and work under fume hood (D436) when working with preservative.
